# Linkedin Post Scraper ✅ No cookies

The Apify actor [`supreme_coder/linkedin-post`](https://apify.com/supreme_coder/linkedin-post) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **1.3.63**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape unlimited Linkedin posts without risking your Linkedin account. Live data, Super fast scraping at affordable cost. High success rate

## Pricing

Pay per event — Cost per post scraped $0.002, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/supreme_coder/linkedin-post) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/supreme-coder-linkedin-post@1.3.63#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      urls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls` | array | yes |  | Source URLs — Supported URLs: Linkedin post search URL, Linkedin user or company profile URL, Linkedin post URL |
| `limitPerSource` | integer |  |  | Limit per source — Limit number of posts scraped per source URL, leave empty for unlimited |
| `scrapeUntil` | string |  |  | Scrape until date — Use this field if you want to only scrape posts newer than given date |
| `deepScrape` | boolean |  | `true` | Scrape additional information — Get more information such as likes, comments etc |
| `fetchDocumentDetails` | boolean |  | `false` | Fetch document details — Fetch attached document details from posts with transcripts and all available pages as images. If not enabled, only first 4 page images will be available |
| `numComments` | integer |  |  | Number of comments to fetch — Number of comments to fetch for each post |
| `numLikes` | integer |  |  | Number of likes to fetch — Number of liked users to fetch for each post |
| `rawData` | boolean |  | `false` | Get raw data (Advanced) — Push the scraped data directly to the dataset without any processing and filtering. This might be useful if you are looking for some missing data in the dataset |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
